status.slow: Calculating, this takes longer than usual...

panels.resizeHint: Arrow keys change the width, Home and End set the limit

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.loadFailed: Could not load the inputs of the version
inputs.emptyTitle: The outcome does not depend on inputs
inputs.emptyLead: This version has no inputs that would change the outcome.
inputs.allInert: No input changes the result with the current selection.

example.label: Dataset
example.hint: Changes the names and field values of the example, not the structure of the result.

inert.title: No effect
inert.lead: With the current selection these inputs do not change the result sections. You can still switch them to check.
inert.minor: The result sections stay the same, only details such as file names change. Read by {{count}} rules.

links.title: Result elements linked to the input "{{name}}"

result.emptyLead: Add a document in the version form and the outcome will appear here.
result.stale: The previous outcome is shown: the new one could not be loaded.

documents.whyUnknown: the reason is not in the response
documents.fallback: No {{lang}} edition: the default language is used

meta.empty: The project has no fields or questionnaires in this combination.
meta.whyUnknown: the reason is not in the response

forms.offBlock: Do not apply in this combination

points.openDocLabel: Show the document "{{name}}" in the Documents section

off.absent: document is not in the set

points.whyUnknown: the reason is not in the response

sections.stub: The content of this section arrives in the next slice.

rules.noTerms: No conditions: the rule sets an order.

builtin.nda_gate: This rule is built into the Studio: under an NDA the document is turned off.
builtin.manuals_gate: This rule is built into the Studio: it reads the “Manuals” field.
builtin.presentation_variant: This rule is built into the Studio: it picks the presentation variant.
builtin.builtin_route: The built-in signing order: neither the version nor the point set its own.
builtin.other: This rule is built into the Studio and cannot be changed here.

drawer.title: Files
drawer.lead: Picking a file opens the Files mode: the editor with the Source and Form tabs.

phone.readOnly: Editing is available on a computer.

part.failedStale: Could not refresh the "{{name}}" section: showing the previous data

document_state.absent: Document "{{doc}}" is not in the project

item_active.no: Item "{{doc}}" of point "{{point}}" is not active

route_pair.yes: Signer "{{persona}}" is in the route: document "{{doc}}", slot {{slot}}, point "{{point}}"
route_pair.no: Signer "{{persona}}" is not in the route: document "{{doc}}", slot {{slot}}, point "{{point}}"

pale.none: No single input brings this in
pale.failed: Could not find an input, press again

documents.title: Documents
documents.empty: There are no documents in this combination.

fields.title: What to fill in
fields.lead: Required project fields and questionnaires the student has to fill in.

route.title: Who signs
route.lead: Signing order for each submission point.
route.empty: There are no signatures in this combination.

preview.needWorkTree: The preview builds the working tree: pick “Working tree” in “Result from”.
preview.title: PDF preview
preview.lead: Built on test data, nothing is sent. The server builds the PDF.
preview.noDocument: The preview does not build this document.
preview.variantLangHint: Unavailable variants are greyed out: the project language is {{lang}}.
preview.variantNoPdf: This variant does not produce a PDF: the build will end without one.
preview.autoHint: Rebuild after the inputs, scenario or files change. Off until you turn it on.
preview.hint: Press “Build” to see the PDF. Auto-build rebuilds it after edits.
preview.staleFiles: Files changed after the build: the PDF may be out of date. Build again.
preview.staleInputs: The inputs, scenario or variant changed after the build: the PDF shows the earlier choice.
preview.quota: {{limit}} preview builds are already running, no more are allowed.
preview.cachedLead: From cache: a build with the same data already existed, the document was not built again.

failure.busyLead: Try again in {{seconds}} s. Calculations are rate limited: if the error stays, wait a minute.
failure.atlasLead: The table would have {{rows}} rows with a limit of {{limit}}. Pin some inputs: pinned values cut the table.
failure.atlasLeadPlain: Pin some inputs: pinned values cut the table.
failure.tooLargeLead: The answer would take {{size}} MiB with a limit of {{limit}} MiB. Choose fewer scenarios.
failure.tooLargeLeadPlain: The answer is over the limit. Choose fewer scenarios.

noBase.no_git: The workspace is a plain folder without git: it has neither a last commit nor a base.
noBase.no_base: The workspace has no base branch. Fetch it in the Files section or compare two scenarios.
noBase.new_version: This version is not in the main branch: it is new, so there is nothing to compare it with. Compare two scenarios.
noBase.unknown: The version is not in the main branch, or the workspace is not connected to a repository.

failure.inputsTitle: The inputs do not fit the version
failure.rateLead: The linter is limited to 6 requests per minute. Retry in {{seconds}} s or wait a minute.

matrix.againstNoGit: Needs a workspace with git: a plain folder has no base
matrix.group: group {{letter}}: the section result is the same in these scenarios
matrix.legend: Cells: {{matched}} matched, {{changed}} changed, {{unchecked}} not checked, {{error}} with an error. The same letters in a column mean the scenarios do not differ in that section; the “~” mark means the section changed against the base.
matrix.emptyLead: Save the current inputs as a scenario, and after edits the Studio will show what changed.
matrix.noDiff: The section matches the expectation, no mismatch.
matrix.noDiffList: There is no detailed change list for this cell: open the scenario.
matrix.emptyBroken_one: No readable scenarios, one file has an error. Open the scenario list and fix it.
matrix.emptyBroken_other: No readable scenarios, {{count}} files have errors. Open the scenario list and fix them.

atlas.loading: Calculating the atlas, this may take a few seconds
atlas.cancelledLead: The atlas is not calculated. Calculate it again when you need it.
atlas.noDimensions: The result does not depend on inputs: there are no dimensions and the atlas has one row.
atlas.dimensionsLead: Inputs whose value changes something in the result. The rest are collected below under “No effect”.

reason.cosmetic: changes only file names, the edition language or document variants

atlas.searchPlaceholder: Search by value, input or outcome (key /)
atlas.noResults: Nothing found. Reset the search or filters.
atlas.detailNone: The current inputs are not in the table: some inputs are pinned to other values.
atlas.pinChooseLead: Choose the input values that need no enumeration: the atlas will be calculated again with fewer rows.

compare.identicalLead: The result on the left ({{left}}) and on the right ({{right}}) is the same in every section.
compare.identicalSame: Both sides are the same. Choose different scenarios, inputs or states.

impact.title: What changes in the result
impact.headChanged_one: The result will change in {{changed}} of {{total}} scenario
impact.headChanged_other: The result will change in {{changed}} of {{total}} scenarios
impact.headSame_one: The result will not change in the only scenario
impact.headSame_other: The result will not change in any of {{total}} scenarios
impact.headNoScenarios: The template has no scenarios: nothing to compare the result against
impact.atlas: Atlas: {{changed}} of {{total}} rows will change, outcomes {{before}} before and {{after}} after.
impact.atlasNull: The atlas is too large, compared by scenarios only.
impact.scenarioErrorPlain: The scenario cannot be read on one of the sides.
impact.loading: Calculating what changes for students, {{seconds}} s...
impact.busyRetry: The server is busy, retrying in {{seconds}} s...
impact.busyLead: Retry in {{seconds}} s. Calculations are rate limited: if the error stays, wait a minute.
impact.tooLargeLead: The response exceeds the limit. Open Matrix and Compare on the Result screen to see differences per scenario.
impact.failedTitle: Could not compute before and after
impact.notBlocking: You can still send the changes for review.

cancelled.title: Calculation cancelled
cancelled.lead: You can send the changes for review without it.

released.title: The version is released and immutable
released.lead: Edits do not reach version {{version}}, so there is nothing to compare.

no_git.title: A folder without git
no_git.lead: The workspace is not connected to a repository, so there is nothing to compare with. You can send the changes for review without a comparison.

no_base.title: Nothing to compare with
no_base.lead: The workspace has no main branch. Fetch it in Content, All files, and the comparison will appear here.

new_version.title: The version is new, nothing to compare
new_version.lead: This version is not in the main branch, so there is no "before". You can send the changes for review without a comparison.

unknown.title: Nothing to compare with
unknown.lead: The version is not in the main branch, or the workspace is not connected to a repository.

noScenarios.title: No scenarios
noScenarios.lead: Scenarios are checks of the result: without them a condition edit goes unnoticed. Create at least one.

impact.warning: The result of these scenarios will change. Review the differences above: a confirmation is required to continue.

pr.head_one: **The result will change in {{changed}} of {{total}} scenario**
pr.head_other: **The result will change in {{changed}} of {{total}} scenarios**
pr.headNone: Scenario results are unchanged ({{total}} in total)
pr.atlas: Atlas: {{changed}} of {{total}} rows will change, outcomes {{before}} before and {{after}} after
